Subject: Design Team Lunch — This Friday? (Bring your appetite & your best font puns)

Hi Design Crew,

Who’s up for a midweek—wait, Friday—feast? Let’s take a break from pixels and prototypes and refuel together this Friday at 12:30 PM. No agenda, just good food, bad puns, and the world’s most critical design critiques: napkin sketches.

Options: pizza, tacos, sushi, or surprise me. Reply with an emoji to vote: 🍕 🍣 🌮 🎲  
If you’ve got dietary needs or a preferred spot nearby, shout it out — we’ll pick based on votes.

Meet in the lobby/kitchen at 12:25 to walk over together, unless you prefer to rendezvous directly at the restaurant.

Hope to see you there (and yes, you can bring extra snacks for moral support).

Cheers,  
[Your Name]

Note: This is a draft only — I won’t send it. Tell me if you want a different tone, time, or location.
